title: LR warmup at DEPTH=9
description: Changed WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 (5% linear LR ramp from 0 to peak), all else at DEPTH=9 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.002883, worse than the 0.998924 baseline. Warmup is a clean negative at this width/depth -- the immediate-full-LR start was not actually hurting; adding a ramp just wastes early high-LR steps. All three agents proposed this identical experiment independently this round, so this should be treated as a settled, well-confirmed negative -- don't retest warmup at width=640 again.
